name: YouTube Shorts

counting.notes: Title hard limit is 100 chars (description is 5,000 chars). Angle brackets '<' and '>' are disallowed by YouTube API.

hashtags.excessBehavior: CRITICAL: Exceeding 60 hashtags causes YouTube to silently ignore ALL hashtags on the video.
hashtags.notes: Only the first 3 hashtags display prominently. Keep to 3-5 targeted tags.

links.recommendedStrategy: Links in Shorts descriptions & comments are non-clickable; use the native Related Video link or channel profile links.
links.notes: YouTube disabled clickable URLs in Shorts descriptions and pinned comments to curb spam.

organic.label: YouTube Shorts Organic (tall top header + wide right action stack)

ad.label: YouTube Shorts Paid Ad (Google Vertical Ad Spec: 15% top, 35% bottom, 17.78% right)

oauth.gotcha: Google OAuth refresh tokens expire in 7 days if the Cloud project stays in 'Testing' publishing status; move to Production for non-expiring refresh tokens. 16:9 videos <=3 min are silently classified as long-form, NOT Shorts — must be 9:16 or 1:1. Audio fingerprinting blocks videos with unlicensed commercial music. YouTube disabled clickable URLs in Shorts descriptions and pinned comments to curb spam.

sources: YouTube Help (3-min Shorts expansion Oct 2024, 60-hashtag ignore-all policy, 100-char title)
